links.outcome: Customized LLM accuracy on Korean-language questions with Korean versus English medical terminology
links.effect: Customized LLM answered 8/15 correctly with Korean terms; replacing Korean terms with English improved performance by two additional knowledge-based questions, matching the fellow's score.
links.quote: When the standardized Korean medical terms were replaced with English terminology, the LLM's performance improved, answering two additional knowledge-based questions correctly, matching the fellow's score.

links.outcome: LLM scores compared with gastroenterology fellow and expert on the same 15 questions
links.effect: Customized LLM 8/15, fellow 10/15, conventional GPT-4o 14/15, expert 15/15.
links.quote: While the customized LLM correctly answered 8 out of 15 questions, the fellow answered 10 correctly.

unlisted_practices: Chain-of-thought prompt engineering to improve reasoning (did not improve customized GPT performance)

screen.practice: retrieval grounding on textbooks (customized RAG GPT) vs conventional GPT-4o
screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance of LLMs on clinical gastroenterology questions, testing specific practices/safeguards including RAG and chain-of-thought prompt engineering compared to baseline.
